headline: Fiserv Shares Rally on Signs of Third-Quarter Turnaround
summary: Fiserv stock surged on Tuesday after the company posted third-quarter results showing signs of a potential operational turnaround.
why: Fiserv is a leading global provider of financial services technology and payment processing systems, serving banks and merchants worldwide.

impacts.name: Fiserv
impacts.why: Evidence of a turnaround in quarterly results boosts investor confidence in future earnings growth.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
